brief: Big, immaculate gambrel dairy barn about 44 ft wide and 90 ft long, painted bright barn red with white trim: rows of small white-cased six-pane stall windows and several white-framed doors along the ground floor, a large hay door outlined in white under the gable peak with a small hay hood, and white outlined square panels on the gable. Weathered grey shingle gambrel roof with two metal ventilator cupolas with pointed caps and a weathervane. A concrete stave silo, corrugated grain bins and an steel-bladed windmill stand behind.
